title: Jubilant Venezuelan Date Pudding
description: A sweet and fluffy Venezuelan dessert featuring dates and miniature marshmallows, perfect for a date night, and friendly to Buddhist temple dietary standards
instructions: Preheat the oven to 375 degrees Fahrenheit.
In a blender or food processor, puree the dates until smooth.
In a medium bowl, whisk together the flour, baking powder, and salt.
In a large bowl, whisk together the brown sugar, eggs, and vanilla extract.
Add the flour mixture to the sugar mixture and stir until just combined.
Fold in the pureed dates and melted butter until well combined.
Gently fold in the miniature marshmallows.
Divide the batter evenly among 6 ramekins.
Place the ramekins on a baking sheet and bake for 20 minutes.
Remove the puddings from the oven and let them cool for 5 minutes.
Serve the puddings warm, garnished with additional miniature marshmallows if desired.
